DANDELION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, in order of priority "middle - below - above"
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}may react to certain strong winds

{FLAVOR}"Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head. "I’m not a leprechaun and I’m not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don’t even know how that rumor got started."
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.
DANDELION_TOOLTIP: Attacks multiple lanes, one lane at a time

DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}will target stronger specials in its lane before other zombies
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}has a limited supply of darts, then must recharge

{FLAVOR}"Why waste shots on foot soldiers when you can win the battle with one well-chosen dart to the dome?" wonders Dartichoke. "Why would you do it? Why would ANYONE do it?"
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dartichokes fire high-damage darts down the lane, prioritizing especially dangerous zombies such as Wizards, Octo Zombies, and Fishermen.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grows and releases stalling gas every fifteen shots, can grow a maximum of twice

{FLAVOR}"I use they/them pronouns," says Dazey Chain. "Duh," they add.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dazey Chains grow through stages, becoming more powerful and releasing a stalling puff of gas at each stage.
DAZEYCHAIN_TOOLTIP: Grows flowers from time to time and stalls zombies
DEFEAT_ALLSTAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their team spirit is too overwhelming!
DEFEAT_ARCADE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Gamers in a game? Too meta!
DEFEAT_BARREL_ROLLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Barrels are for storing things, not for smushing plants!
DEFEAT_BASICS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Time to get back to basics, and thin out the zombie horde!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their pompadours and bikinis may be stylish, but they're still brain-eaters!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE: Defeat Basic Big Wave Beach Zombies!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Teach these zombies that buckets are for making sand castles.
DEFEAT_BEACH_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Better beat these beach blanket bozos!
DEFEAT_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're zombies, but they look like weird crabs! Ick!
DEFEAT_BEACH_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Half fish, half imp. Entirely gross.
DEFEAT_BIGBRAINZ_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: Who celebrates going back to school? WHO?!
DEFEAT_BIRTHDAYZ_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They don't want to celebrate, they just want your brains!
DEFEAT_BLOCKHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their headgear is simply too geometric!
DEFEAT_BOOMBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their emotions are too raw, too honest!
DEFEAT_BREAKDANCER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their fly moves are simply intolerable!
DEFEAT_BUCKETS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Time to make these zombies kick the bucket!
DEFEAT_BUG_REPEATABLE_DESC: Bug/zombie symbiosis is just too creepy!
DEFEAT_BULLRIDER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They look like bulls, but they're actually robots! GET 'EM!
DEFEAT_BULLY_REPEATABLE_DESC: Bones in beards are questionably fashionable!
DEFEAT_CAMEL_REPEATABLE_DESC: That camel-flauge isn't fooling anyone. Show those zombies they can't hide from you!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Wipe that nasty smile off their faces!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_REPEATABLE_DES: It's up to you to end this never-ending sibling rivalry!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_REPEATABLE_DE: Put out those ill-placed fiery dispositions!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Outmatch these braggarts and show them how a real strongman does it!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: Show them that their practical stunts are no more than an outdated trend!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Two heads are better off dead!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: We're no strangers to magic abilities. Show them why they're no longer special!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MIRROR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their anomalous illusions need to be shattered!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC: Put these hollow freaks to sleep before they play frightening lullabies!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: These pranks are getting way too far! Put a dent in their malevolent smiles!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_REPEATABLE_DES: Someone needs to humble them down!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their stunts are dangerous, and frankly irresponsible!
DEFEAT_CHICKEN_FARMER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They wrangled just one too many chickens!
DEFEAT_CONES_REPEATABLE_DESC: Practice a little garden safety by culling out Conehead Zombies!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: These cow-punching, boot-wearing ghouls need some good ol' fashioned frontier justice!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: In my day, buckets were for mucking the stables!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Send these cone rangers to the pokey!
DEFEAT_CRYSTALSKULL_REPEATABLE_DESC: Those weird skulls shouldn't be able to do what they do!
DEFEAT_DARK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're not pleasant, they're peasant! And that's terrible!
DEFEAT_DARK_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They'll never be knights with low-tier equipment like that!
DEFEAT_DARK_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their big stone hammers are clumsy and all too effective!
DEFEAT_DARK_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: These monks ain't funky! Except for their smell.
DEFEAT_DINO_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Zombie like cone. You not a zombie. Crush cone!
DEFEAT_DINO_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their mean little giggles are super unsettling!
DEFEAT_DISCO_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their 70s disco rhythms don't belong in their far-future era!
DEFEAT_DODO_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who knew dodos could be such jerks?
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Bare-headed, cone-wearing or bucket-bearing, these basic bandaged brutes have got to go!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: These pail-packers need to go pound sand!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Don't they have a pyramid to build, or something?
DEFEAT_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Wrap things up by taking care of some Mummified Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're always growling about obscure bands!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE: Defeat Basic Neon Mixtape Tour Zombies!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES: They don't know what it means to be a metalhead!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their traffic cone and denim look is SO out of style.
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE: They need to learn at least two chords!
DEFEAT_EXCAVATOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Shovels just shouldn't be that effective! Punish them!
DEFEAT_EXPANSION_RANDOM_LEVEL_REPEATABLE: Use your leveled-up plants to tackle extra-tough veteran zombies in expert levels! Warning: May Be Tense!
DEFEAT_EXPLORER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Somebody needs to teach these zombies that playing with fire is dangerous. That somebody is you!
DEFEAT_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: Looks like their only present is going to be an old-fashioned beating!
DEFEAT_FISHERMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: Because seriously. These guys. They need to go away.
DEFEAT_FOODFIGHT_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They contribute to the food waste epidemic! Stop them!
DEFEAT_FOOTBALL_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC: How dare they shove your plants like they do?
DEFEAT_FOSSILHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC: A skull on a head is one skull too many!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They have shiny jumpsuits and awful, carnivorous intentions!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They need to upgrade to the zCone 7 anyway.
DEFEAT_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: They have telephone poles for arms! TELEPHONE POLES!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They scamper around in creepy little spider-bots! Brrrrrr!
DEFEAT_GARGANTUARS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Take on the big boys by taking out some random Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_GLITTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Roller skates are more of a 70s thing anyway!
DEFEAT_HUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Because snowballs are preposterous hunting gear!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They lack technological sophistication! Punish them for it!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: I've heard of ice buckets, but this is ridiculous!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're all just evolutionary dead ends!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: These lunkheads don't even have the decency to be slothful!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Unfortunately these yetis are anything but scarce.
DEFEAT_IMPPORTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: How do they pack all those zombies in there? It strains credulity!
DEFEAT_IMPS_REPEATABLE_DESC: These things are just weird. Please get rid of them!
DEFEAT_JETPACK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Why do they get jetpacks? It's so unfair!
DEFEAT_JUGGLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're constantly ripping off other funnier zombies' material!
DEFEAT_KING_REPEATABLE_DESC: They refuse to govern with the consent of the governed!
DEFEAT_KNIGHT_REPEATABLE_DESC: They work too hard upholding a regressive feudal system!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their exploratory efforts are highly questionable!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES: Buckets. Why did it have to be buckets?
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Impressive mustache or no, these guys have got to go!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE: They just lug too much stuff around!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their helmets are just the piths!
DEFEAT_LOST_PILOT_REPEATABLE_DESC: Nobody should have ever issued them a license to fly!
DEFEAT_MCZOMBIE_REPEATABLE_DESC: How dare they spin their mics that way!
DEFEAT_MECH_CONE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Robo-cone zombies are too cylindrical to be allowed!
DEFEAT_MODERN_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their contemporary crimes may not be countenanced!
DEFEAT_MODERN_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Make them kick the... well, you know.
DEFEAT_MODERN_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: A traffic cone is a timeless look for a zombie. But you're not a zombie, so smash 'em!
DEFEAT_MODERN_GARGANTUAR_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're really just big softies. Make sure they know that.
DEFEAT_NEWSPAPER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They already threw out the comics section!
DEFEAT_OCTOPUS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Enslaving octopuses for zombie purposes is just not cool!
DEFEAT_PARASOL_REPEATABLE_DESC: Those parasols are just too fancy and expensive!
DEFEAT_PHARAOH_REPEATABLE_DESC: These Pharaohs think that they rule, but they'll never defeat you in a duel!
DEFEAT_PIANO_REPEATABLE_DESC: They can't even read sheet music!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Swab the decks with their leaky headgear!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_REPEATABLE_DESC: Do it before they mutate into Pirate Admiral Zombies!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Cross their crossbones off the list!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Turn these cannoneers into cannon fodder!
DEFEAT_PONCHO_REPEATABLE_DESC: What are they hiding under their ponchos? You can never tell!
DEFEAT_PROSPECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: And defeat their scruffy prospector beards, too!
DEFEAT_PROTECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: E.M.Peaches make short work of these technological terrors!
DEFEAT_PUNK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their jackets and boots have too many spikes!
DEFEAT_PVZHEVENT_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're imposters! They aren't the REAL heroes!
DEFEAT_RA_REPEATABLE_DESC: Ra Zombies are out to soak up your sun - time to make them ancient history!
DEFEAT_RELICHUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Teach them it's better to leave relics where they are!
DEFEAT_SEAGULL_REPEATABLE_DESC: How can a seagull that small carry a zombie? It's ridiculous!
DEFEAT_SNORKEL_REPEATABLE_DESC: They wear snorkels when they don't even need to breathe!
DEFEAT_SPRINGENING_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DES: Because their dumb boiled eggs smell horrible!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BACK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: You're going the wrong way, stupid!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BARREL_REPEATABLE_DESC: You might want to give them a mint, but don't allow them to come near any of yours!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their industrial revolts will NOT be tolerated!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Having a fire hazard around coal? That cannot go unpunished!
DEFEAT_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Don't worry about it, they're already heartless!
DEFEAT_STEAM_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their cones must not industrially advance!
DEFEAT_STEAM_FURNACE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Having a furnace strapped to your back has got to be a safety violation!
DEFEAT_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Throw a wrench in THEIR plans!
DEFEAT_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: According to all known laws of aviation, they shouldn't be able to fly!
DEFEAT_STEAM_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They shouldn't even be allowed to work!
DEFEAT_STEAM_INVENTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: She shouldn't have even passed the job interview!
DEFEAT_STEAM_MECHANIC_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their endless mass production is offsetting the job market!
DEFEAT_STEAM_MINER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They don't even mine the coal! They just transport it!
DEFEAT_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They don't even work here, get them outta here!
DEFEAT_SUMMERNIGHTS_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DE: Didn't anyone tell them not to hold fireworks? Proper safety is important!
DEFEAT_SURFER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're throwing away a perfectly good post-secondary education!
DEFEAT_SWASHBUCKLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who do they think they are, buckling those swashes?
DEFEAT_TOMB_RAISER_REPEATABLE_DESC: It's time for these Tomb Raisers to learn that messing with you was a grave mistake!
DEFEAT_TREASURE_YETI_REPEATABLE_DESC: What secrets are contained within its lunchbox? Only one way to find out!
DEFEAT_TROGLOBITE_REPEATABLE_DESC: That iceblock-shoving trick of theirs is way over the line.
DEFEAT_VALENBRAINZ_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DES: Because they just don't have the heart to feel love!
DEFEAT_WEASELHOARDER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who hoards weasels inside a log? WHO???
DEFEAT_WEST_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Get them before they get you!
DEFEAT_WIZARD_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their dark transformative powers must not be abided!
DEFEAT_ZCORP_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They keep injecting our holidays with the horrors of capitalism! Fight off the establishment!

DINONIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}affects all dinosaurs in a lane
{FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
DINONIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.

DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}air cannon blasts have a chance to blow away critters, imps and shrunken zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food blasts knock flying zombies off the lawn

{FLAVOR}Draftodil looks like she's full of hot air, but she isn't. She's full of highly compressed air. There's a difference!
DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Draftodils windmill constantly, slowing flying zombies, and also shoot air cannon blasts that deal light damage to zombies.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Dusk Lobbers lob buds down 3 lanes

{FLAVOR}Lobbing comes easily to Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane.

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Blueberry prides herself on being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep 'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when it's disintegrated."
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (electric fence)

{FLAVOR}"Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dipping tea bags into a cup of water has always been the way to prepare your tea, but doing so with him might not be such a good idea. Actually, just don't consume Electrici-tea in general.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electrici-teas wait and emit zaps of electrical energy until they are eaten, at which point the eating zombies explode in a flurry of electrical discharges.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Peashooter expects resistance, but he doesn't want to ohm anybody.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Peashooters fire pea-like orbs that pass through zombies and crackle with electrical power, doing damage all the while.
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Has grown tired of people lazily calling him E.M. Pea. "There's a C and H there for a reason people! And I've got the stone to prove it!"
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: E.M.Peaches explode and disable all machines in an area.
EMPEA_TOOLTIP: Disables all machines in an area

ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"When other plants talk about me, they say I’m too gruff. They say I’m difficult to approach, that I’m afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he’s so much more than that. He’s also short-tempered.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
